title: Test a replica-set client contract
description: Select write and read guarantees, then inject a topology condition. The model shows which path survives, what the client can claim, and where ambiguity or staleness remains.

writes.label: Primary acknowledgment
writes.detail: Return after the primary applies the operation. Lower coordination, with rollback exposure before majority commit.

writes.label: Majority acknowledgment
writes.detail: Wait for the calculated majority commit boundary. More durable, but dependent on a reachable voting majority.

reads.label: Primary + local
reads.detail: Read the current primary without limiting results to majority-committed state.

reads.label: Primary + majority
reads.detail: Read majority-committed state from the primary for a durable view.

reads.label: Secondary preferred + local
reads.detail: Allow a secondary to serve local state. Useful for tolerant reads, but the value can lag or roll back.

reads.label: Primary + linearizable
reads.detail: Confirm a valid primary and preserve real-time order for a single-document read, with higher coordination cost.

failures.label: Healthy replica set
failures.detail: One primary and two secondaries are reachable.

failures.label: One secondary is lagging
failures.detail: The primary is writable, but a secondary is behind and is a risky source for freshness-sensitive reads.

failures.label: Primary election in progress
failures.detail: No primary accepts writes during the election; reachable secondaries may still serve eligible reads.

failures.label: Client reaches a minority
failures.detail: The reachable side cannot elect a primary or satisfy a majority write contract.
